title: decrypt.rs: ukm allocates Vec then immediately borrows as slice
description: try_decrypt_kari line 201: kari.ukm.as_ref().map(|u| u.as_bytes().to_vec()) allocates a Vec<u8> from an OctetString (which already owns its bytes) only to immediately borrow it via ukm.as_deref() on line 238. The allocation is unnecessary — OctetString::as_bytes() returns &[u8] directly and kari lives for the duration of the function, so let ukm = kari.ukm.as_ref().map(|u| u.as_bytes()) yields Option<&[u8]> with no heap allocation and no .as_deref() needed.
